scenario: A report treats a generated reviewer_pack.zip or audit zip as the final acceptance decision for paper business capability.
input_report_features: EvidenceManifest.artifacts includes reviewer_pack.zip and audit.zip with hashes. ExecutionReport.status='accepted' and final_verdict='business capability accepted' solely because the zip files exist. No independent reviewer_decision, human_gate_ref, or final acceptance authority is present. The producer of the zip is also treated as the approver.
expected_findings: Generated reviewer or audit zip was treated as final acceptance
Evidence producer self-approved the paper business capability
Missing independent reviewer decision or human acceptance record
Reviewer packs and audit zips are evidence inputs only
